title: hieracium pulmonarioides subsp. spelaeum
intro: Hieracium pulmonarioides subsp. spelaeum, commonly known as the cave hawk's beard, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion-like genus Hieracium. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant involve its ability to soothe digestive issues and alleviate respiratory problems due to its expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Hieracium pulmonarioides subsp. spelaeum include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
